phase: Phase C4 - DE440 vs the production DE421 planetary ephemeris: materiality survey (analysis only, no production change)
written: 2026-10-23, before any C4 number was computed (a scoping look at |DE440 - DE421| of the Moon-centred Earth (3.5-4.0 m) and Sun (200-217 m) and of the Moon's SSB position (~115.5 km, the DE440 barycentre redefinition) over 2027-03 was taken to scope the gates; it is not a survey result)
motivation: Production loads de421.bsp (spice_loader.REQUIRED_KERNELS) while the high-order lunar gravity frame is MOON_PA_DE440 and current DSN/IERS practice uses DE440. The Orekit/GMAT trial listed the DE421/DE440 inconsistency as finding 5. C4 measures what the ephemeris choice does to this project's observables and OD
baseline: the C2-I/C3-I measurement stack: DSN_C2_LIGHT_TIME_MODEL, exact-epoch production station providers, no station displacement; KP2 SIMPLIFIED dynamics (Moon point mass + J2 + SRP; no third-body gravity, frozen for the canonical baseline), all with de421.bsp

terms.T1_EARTH_POSITION: the station's Moon-centred position moves by dE(t) = E_DE440(t) - E_DE421(t) (Moon-centred Earth), applied as a station perturbation (spline on a 60 s grid) with the light-time solve otherwise on DE421
terms.T2_SSB_EPHEMERIS: the barycentric light-time quantities (the Moon's SSB state, Shapiro body positions) read from DE440 (de440.bsp furnished after de421.bsp), stations unchanged
terms.T3_SRP_SUN: the trajectory propagated with the Sun direction for SRP from DE440 instead of DE421 (same x0, same K), observables recomputed on it

observables: two-way range and counted Doppler (Tc 60 s) on all KP2 rows of the 10 cells, delta-DOR on CANON k0 Goldstone-Canberra; exact re-solve per variant
kernel_handling: variants are computed in each worker by furnishing de440.bsp and unloading it again; gate S1 checks that unloading restores the DE421 state bit for bit

gates.S1_kernel_restore: after unload(de440.bsp), the Moon-centred Earth position and the Moon's SSB position at 20 epochs per cell equal the values before furnsh, bit for bit
gates.S2_sanity: max |dE| per cell within [0.5, 50] m (gross-error screen)
gates.S3_interpolation: spline dE vs direct SPICE differences at 200 random epochs per cell <= 1e-6 m
gates.S5_propagation: the DE421 trajectory recomputed in the worker equals the cell's KP2 trajectory bit for bit (the T3 difference is the Sun ephemeris alone)

noise_levels.PROJECT: range 5 m, Doppler 1e-4 m/s, delta-DOR 5 nrad
noise_levels.DSN_REALISTIC: range 1 m, Doppler 3e-5 m/s, delta-DOR 5 nrad

od_impact: the C2 linear bias mapping (RANGE_ONLY, RANGE_DOPPLER_FREE_BIAS; PROJECT, DSN_REALISTIC)

materiality_rule.observable_level: OBSERVABLE_MATERIAL if max |effect| >= 0.1 sigma at DSN_REALISTIC
materiality_rule.decision: MATERIAL or DOCUMENT_ONLY per term. Fixed in advance: switching the production ephemeris re-baselines every synthetic result and every frozen numerical record, so an implementation (C4-I) is an OWNER DECISION whatever the survey finds; this phase only measures and recommends
materiality_rule.gate_veto: a failed S1, S3, S4 or S5 makes the affected term C4_INCONCLUSIVE; computed-as-FAIL gates are reported

not_in_scope: third-body gravity (absent from the frozen KP2 dynamics; its DE440 effect is recorded as a follow-up), lunar libration/PA (DE421 vs DE440 PA is covered by the high-order gravity closure), any production change
